title: Claims police, CBI, customs or TRAI are after you
why: No agency arrests anyone over a phone or video call, takes payment to close a case, or asks you to stay on the line. This is the 'digital arrest' scam that has cost people crores.
examples: This is CBI. A parcel in your name was found with drugs. You are under digital arrest, stay on video call.
TRAI notice: your mobile number will be disconnected in 2 hours due to illegal activity.
Mumbai Police has registered an FIR against your Aadhaar for money laundering.
safe: RBI has announced new guidelines for digital payments.
Police verification for your passport is scheduled for 5 November at 11 am.
